build_tiny_models: build tiny random models for specified HuggingFace Transformers architectures and save checkpoints to disk
create_tiny_models_cli: create tiny random models for all or selected model types via argparse CLI with optional Hub upload
build_composite_models: build composite encoder-decoder models like VisionEncoderDecoderModel from pre-trained encoder and decoder components
build_processor: build tokenizer and feature extractor processors from HuggingFace model checkpoints with automatic fallback resolution
upload_tiny_models: upload generated tiny model checkpoints to a HuggingFace Hub organization repository
